ngrok-api.$comment: All requests to the ngrok API.

ngrok-read-all.$comment: Read anything from the ngrok API.

ngrok-write-all.$comment: Create, update, delete, or run actions (e.g. restart/stop a tunnel session) through the ngrok API.

ngrok-read-credentials.$comment: List and inspect tunnel credentials (the ngrok agent authtokens used to bring up tunnels).

ngrok-write-credentials.$comment: Mint, update, or delete tunnel credentials (create the ngrok agent authtokens used to bring up tunnels).
